education.thesisTitle: Spatial Understanding for Camera-based Autonomous Driving Perception and 3D Visual Grounding

descriptionItems: Achieved a 3.54% (Nr3D) and 6.74% (ScanRefer) accuracy improvement in 3D Visual Grounding by proposing Relational Depth Text (RDT).
Optimized UniAD for edge-device deployment, reducing memory footprint by ~80% via advanced model lightweighting techniques.
Engineered an Object Mask Module for ViewFormer to enhance 3D Occupancy Prediction within complex urban environments.

experience.organization: Dept. of Future Automotive Engineering (Shinhan Univ.)
descriptionItems: Authored 4 conference papers (IEIE, ITFE) regarding robust lane detection and resource-constrained LiDAR control.
Proposed an Occlusion Removal technique utilizing DeepLab-V3+ to significantly improve lane recognition stability.
Implemented Real-time Obstacle Avoidance using LiDAR ROI Filtering and Pure-Pursuit on low-compute platforms.
Led the team as a finalist in the 2023 University Creative Mobility Competition (Hosted by MOLIT, KATRI, and KASA).
Architected a full-stack perception system for ERP-42 EV, encompassing robust Lane Detection and Traffic Sign Recognition.
Curated a custom dataset of 3,500 images for South Korean traffic environments and optimized the end-to-end training pipeline.
